pages.text: A $(item)Respawn Totem$() sleeps until woken with a $(item)Totem Key$().$(br2)Once woken it will raise you $(num)three times$(), then sleep again. Your bed is left as it was.
Waking a totem uses up the key, unless that totem already holds you.$(br2)Keys turn up in $(l:world/ruins)ancient ruins$(), and $(l:world/willow)Willow$() sells them once she knows you.
